semiconductor_relevance: High — TXOne Networks provides specialized cybersecurity solutions tailored for semiconductor manufacturing environments, ensuring operational stability and protection against cyber threats.
summary: TXOne Networks offers comprehensive operational technology (OT) security solutions designed to protect semiconductor manufacturing sites from cyber threats. Their solutions include real-time threat detection, network defense, and endpoint protection specifically tailored for industrial control systems.
capabilities: Industrial firewall and IPS solutions for manufacturing site networks
Next-generation antivirus and whitelisting for industrial endpoints
USB media protection and network segmentation

regional_presence.Japan: TXOne Networks is based in Japan, focusing on providing security solutions for local semiconductor manufacturing sites.
